summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests the CMV-MVA Triplex vaccine given to HLA-matched related stem cell donors, to help prevent cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection in patients receiving a stem cell transplant for blood cancers. Donors receive the vaccine or a placebo as an injection into the muscle on day 0, then G-CSF stem cell mobilization on days 5 to 9 and apheresis on days 10 to 14, and recipients are transplanted within 9 weeks of donor vaccination. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; the study is randomized and placebo-controlled, and its stated aim is to see whether it helps prevent CMV infection.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa la vacuna CMV-MVA Triplex administrada a donantes de células madre emparentados con HLA compatible, para ayudar a prevenir la infección por citomegalovirus (CMV) en pacientes que reciben un trasplante de células madre por cánceres de la sangre. Los donantes reciben la vacuna o un placebo como inyección en el músculo el día 0, luego movilización de células madre con G-CSF los días 5 a 9 y aféresis los días 10 a 14; los receptores son trasplantados dentro de las 9 semanas posteriores a la vacunación del donante. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio es aleatorizado y controlado con placebo, y su objetivo declarado es determinar si ayuda a prevenir la infección por CMV.
who_for: Adult donors aged 18 or older who can give informed consent.
Adult recipients aged 18 or older with a planned transplant from a related donor.
Recipients with a blood cancer such as leukemia, lymphoma, myelodysplastic syndrome, or myelofibrosis.
Recipients with an 8/8 HLA-matched related donor and Karnofsky score of 70 or more or ECOG of 2 or less.
not_for: Donors with a prior transplant, or chemotherapy, radiation, or immunotherapy within 21 days before protocol therapy.
Donors who received another vaccine within 30 days before or after the study vaccine.
Donors who are HIV, hepatitis B or C, or HTLV positive.
Recipients with multiple myeloma or a prior allogeneic transplant.
Recipients with autoimmune disease, a prior investigational CMV vaccine, or recent anti-CMV antiviral treatment.
